title: Gör årsredovisningen för ett litet konsultbolag med vinst och utdelning
person: The CEO of a two-person project management company in Luleå who prepares the annual report herself from the trial balance.
review: Tallbacka Projektledning AB, 556000-0002, calendar year 2025 under K2: net sales 1 680 000 kr, result after financial items 353 800 kr, a 60 000 kr periodiseringsfond, tax 60 500 kr and a profit of 233 300 kr; total assets 945 600 kr (2024: 725 200 kr); the 100 000 kr dividend paid in 2025 shown in the changes in equity; 484 300 kr at the meeting's disposal, 150 000 kr proposed as dividend and 334 300 kr carried forward; signed in Luleå on 24 March 2026 by Maria Nordin and Anders Lund.
revised_review: The board proposes 120 000 kr in dividend: 364 300 kr is carried forward; nothing else changes.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
Management report (business, events, multi-year overview, changes in equity, disposition), income statement, balance sheet, notes and signatures, in that order, with the name and organisation number.
Amounts in whole kronor, the unit stated once and kept.
Last year's figures beside this year's on every line, taken from last year's report.
Every subtotal and result line adds up, both years.
Total assets 945 600 kr equal equity and liabilities (2024: 725 200 kr).
The year's result is the same in every place it appears.
The changes in equity run from last year's balance sheet to this year's.
484 300 kr at the meeting's disposal; 150 000 kr dividend and 334 300 kr carried forward (revision: 120 000 kr and 364 300 kr).
Accounting policies, average number of employees and the fixed-asset note, numbered in order, the carrying amount matching the balance sheet.
Both board members sign under a place and date after the year end.
Last year's column repeats the 2024 report's figures, including the 192 600 kr profit and the 110 000 kr periodiseringsfonder.
Tax, the periodiseringsfond and depreciation are taken from the trial balance, never recomputed; the board's statement on the dividend is asked for or left to the board, not written for it.
The revised report proposes 120 000 kr in dividend and carries 364 300 kr forward.
